newsitem.title: JAPAN: NEC obtains U.S. patent on chip-making technology.
newsitem.headline: NEC obtains U.S. patent on chip-making technology.

text.p: NEC Corp said on Wednesday that it has obtained a U.S. patent on its manufacturing technology for advanced dynamic random access memory chips .
The patent covers the structure and manufacturing method for raising the surface area of capacitors inside memory chips, a company spokesman said.
The company has also filed for patent in Japan.
The spokesman said that the company aims to turn its net loss on royalties to a net annual income of more than 10 billion yen by 2000.
The spokesman said that the technology is being used to make 64 megabit chips.
